name: Eurovision Song Contest
description: The standard swoosh scheme with a Eurovision wrap behind the wing on both sides: a band of small hearts in oranges, reds and yellow along the rear windows, from over the wing back to the aft door; under the windows the slogan 'IT'S YOUR SHOW, GET OUT THERE' in dark red condensed capitals, and under that the Eurovision Song Contest logo with 'OFFICIAL AIRLINE'. Fin, engines and the forward swoosh as on the standard scheme.

hearts.name: the hearts band, an average of its oranges, reds and yellow

areas.name: band of small hearts along the rear windows (orange, red and yellow, drawn as one field); under the swoosh, which ends it forward
swoosh from the cockpit roof to a point aft of the wing

logos.description: The Eurovision Song Contest logo (the word 'eurovision' with a heart for the v, 'SONG CONTEST' under it) in black, 'OFFICIAL AIRLINE' small beneath, centred under the slogan.
The band of hearts itself: dozens of small overlapping hearts in oranges, reds, yellow and pale pink, densest round the windows behind the wing; the area under it carries its average colour.

titles.style: The easyJet wordmark: very heavy, rounded, soft-serifed lowercase with a capital J, white on the orange over the forward windows, just aft of the front door. Baseline just above the window tops; measured directly off G-UZLY (2024-06-11): cap 0.34, lowercase 0.78 of the J.

The wordmark again, large, in white, set along the fin: its baseline rises at about 60° from near the root (mid-chord) to the tip, reading upward toward the leading edge's top. Drawn horizontal by tools that can't rotate text.

titles.text: IT'S YOUR SHOW, GET OUT THERE
titles.style: Dark red condensed bold capitals under the rear windows, ending just ahead of the aft door (on the right side starting there).

notes: G-UZHS (A320neo) only. Measured on the right side (2026-04-22) fitted to the A320 shape, the left side checked on a terminal-window photo (2026-06-07). The band runs from about x 0.34 (thin, over the wing) to the aft door (0.75), from the windows' bottoms (y 0.09) to y 0.5; its edge is ragged (it's made of hearts), drawn smooth. The slogan x 0.541-0.722, cap height about 0.45 m; the logo centred at x 0.64 under it. easyJet has been the contest's official airline since 2024; one forum thread says a Eurovision livery was painted in Basel in 2025 (perhaps a Swiss aircraft); when G-UZHS got its wrap isn't sourced (plain in March 2022, wrapped by April 2026), so no 'from'. Whether it was removed after the May 2026 contest: still worn in June 2026. The base scheme is the standard's, copied as it stands (2026-11-21).
history: New 2026-11-21 (the maintainer's sightings: G-UZHS seen with the wrap).
